reviews.text: Needed to get our chimney fireplace hearth area repointed. It’s 45 years old and started losing the cement between the bricks. Also put a stainless steel cap on top of the chimney to prevent water intrusion.
reviews.author: Jeffrey S.

reviews.text: DON'T TRUST THIS COMPANY!!!!!!!!! THEY DONT DO THE WORK RIGHT OR THEY DONT KNOW HOW TO WORK ON CHIMNEYS. MY CLIENT'S CHIMNEY IS LEAKING WORSE THAN IT WAS FROM THE BEGINNING.
reviews.author: Donna C.

reviews.text: Great job truly professional, excellent workmanship, and neat as a pen, chimney looks brand new on top couldn’t done it better myself. Thank you for a job. Well done.
reviews.author: Richard K.
